title: Louis Vuitton Keepall 50
subtitle: Monogram canvas, made in France, April 1990
details: Monogram coated canvas, natural vachetta leather trim

examined.title: Date code
examined.text: “MI0940” is heat-embossed on the leather tab riveted inside the opening, where Keepalls of this period carry it. In the post-1990 format the 1st and 3rd digits give the month and the 2nd and 4th the year: April 1990. MI is a French factory.

examined.title: Monogram canvas
examined.text: The Keepall is cut from one continuous piece of canvas, so the monogram runs upside down on one side, as it does here. The print is even and correctly scaled.

examined.title: Hardware
examined.text: Brass zip pulls with cleanly embossed LV logos; the date-code rivet is stamped “LOUIS VUITTON”. Patina consistent with age. The padlock in the photos is not included.

examined.title: Stitching
examined.text: Even mustard-yellow thread on the vachetta handles and tabs, with a consistent stitch length.

examined.title: Interior
examined.text: Unlined, showing the woven backing of the canvas, as expected on a Keepall of this era.

examined.title: Not examined
examined.text: The brand heat stamp was not photographed.

condition: Deep honey patina on the vachetta; darkened handles with scuffs and light surface cracking on the tops.
Water marks and darkening on the side tabs; wear along the leather piping.
Creasing to the canvas from use and storage.
Tarnish on the brass zip pulls; darkening around the date-code rivet.
A few small marks on the interior textile.
No tears in the canvas or open seams observed.
